body.label: Trigger
body.html: Your Locked target becomes Exposed, Prone, or suffers a Core Wound.

body.label: Effect
body.html: End your Lock on the triggering creature and make a ranged attack against it. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage and treat that damage as Breach.

surges.html: If this Reaction deals damage, the target's equipment-granted Defense is reduced by 1 until its next turn.
If this Reaction succeeds, the triggering creature cannot make Reactions against your next Ballistics Action this turn.
